query.name: ca.myblueprint.dem.student
query.sql: WITH cfg AS ( SELECT '' AS school_ids ,7 AS min_student_grade ,0 AS include_legal_name ,0 AS append_middle_name FROM dual ) SELECT TO_CHAR(s.STUDENT_NUMBER) AS a_StudentID ,s.STATE_STUDENTNUMBER AS b_StudentNumber ,TRIM(TRANSLATE(s.FIRST_NAME || NVL2(sm.MIDDLE_NAME, ' ' || sm.MIDDLE_NAME, NULL), '|' || CHR(9) || CHR(10) || CHR(13), ' ')) AS c_FirstName ,TRIM(TRANSLATE(s.LAST_NAME, '|' || CHR(9) || CHR(10) || CHR(13), ' ')) AS d_LastName ,s.GENDER AS e_Gender ,TO_CHAR(s.DOB, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS f_DateOfBirth ,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(1)) AS g_Email ,TO_CHAR(s.GRADE_LEVEL) AS h_Grade ,CASE s.ENROLL_STATUS WHEN 0 THEN '1' WHEN -1 THEN '2' ELSE '3' END AS i_Status ,TO_CHAR(s.SCHOOLID) AS j_SchoolCode ,TRIM(TRANSLATE(s.HOME_ROOM, '|' || CHR(9) || CHR(10) || CHR(13), ' ')) AS k_Homeroom ,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(1)) AS l_ElementarySchoolCode ,TO_CHAR(NVL(TRUNC((SELECT SUM(chs.NUMBER_OF_HOURS) FROM S_ON_STU_COMMUNITY_HOURS_C chs WHERE chs.STUDENTSDCID = s.DCID)), 0)) AS m_CommunityHours ,CASE WHEN PSSR_ON_COMMON.LITERACYREQUIREMENT(s.ID) IN ('E', 'F', 'B') THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS n_LiteracyTest ,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(1)) AS o_Diploma ,TRIM(TRANSLATE(scf.PSCORE_LEGAL_FIRST_NAME, '|' || CHR(9) || CHR(10) || CHR(13), ' ')) AS p_LegalName ,CASE WHEN NVL(s.NEXT_SCHOOL, 0) <> 0 THEN TO_CHAR(s.NEXT_SCHOOL) END AS q_PreRegSchoolCode FROM STUDENTS s LEFT JOIN cfg ON 1=1 LEFT JOIN STUDENTCOREFIELDS scf ON scf.STUDENTSDCID = s.DCID AND cfg.include_legal_name = 1 LEFT JOIN STUDENTS sm ON sm.ID = s.ID AND cfg.append_middle_name = 1 WHERE s.GRADE_LEVEL >= cfg.min_student_grade AND s.ENROLL_STATUS IN (0, -1) AND (cfg.school_ids IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || REPLACE(cfg.school_ids, ' ', '') || ',', ',' || s.SCHOOLID || ',') > 0) ORDER BY s.SCHOOLID, s.STUDENT_NUMBER
